description: Returns the field definitions that apply to one specific Test Record (one test case execution within a Test Run iteration), keyed by field ID: each field's label and type kind (primitive such as `string`/`date`/`text/html`, list, structure, or enumeration with its enum name), including the custom fields configured for its type. Use it before writing to the Test Record (one test case execution within a Test Run iteration) to learn which field keys and value types are valid. For the project-wide definitions of a resource type without a concrete instance, use `getProjectFieldsMetadata`; for global defaults, `getGlobalFieldsMetadata`.

iteration.description: The iteration number identifying which repeated occurrence of this item is being addressed (e.g. which run of a test parameter).

projectId.description: The Polarion project ID (its URL segment, e.g. `myproject`), case-sensitive. Required to scope the request to one project. If the ID is unknown, ask the user; getProjects lists IDs only with global read access.

response_format.description: Response detail level. concise removes redundant HTML and JSON:API metadata and may use a small default fieldset on large lists; detailed preserves the complete response. Defaults to detailed.

testCaseId.description: The Test Case's ID being referenced.

testCaseProjectId.description: The project ID that owns the referenced Test Case — may differ from the project in the request path when the test case is shared from another project.

testRunId.description: The Test Run's ID within its project.

name: getFieldsMetadataForTestRecord
